$comment: Web pattern -> Telegram-native replacement, used by scripts/miniapp_rework.py plan and references/mini-apps/rework.md. rules: one entry per lint rule (MA01-MA33) with the rework stage it belongs to; patterns: things the lint does not judge but a rework replaces. Stages follow orchestration.md section 3: 1 security, 2 native behaviour, 3 Telegram values and trust, 4 theme and type, 5 slop, 6 accessibility and polish.

stages.2: Native behaviour: Telegram's chrome, navigation, dialogs, storage
stages.3: Telegram's own values and trust marks

MA01.telegram: the bot token lives on the server only, read from the environment

MA02.telegram: the server verifies raw initData (HMAC or Ed25519) and reads the user from it

MA33.telegram: send the raw initData (Authorization: tma <initData>); never the client's user object

MA25.telegram: no card fields: the server creates an invoice link, the app opens it

MA26.telegram: send item ids and quantities; the server prices the order

MA27.telegram: invoiceClosed is a hint: unlock from the server's order after successful_payment

MA20.telegram: no web login: initData already identifies the user

MA14.telegram: CloudStorage / DeviceStorage for user data, SecureStorage for secrets

MA04.telegram: telegram-web-app.js first in <head>, before any other script

MA07.telegram: MainButton / SecondaryButton; an own button only as the browser fallback

MA18.telegram: ready() after the first useful screen

MA19.telegram: Telegram's header and BackButton driven by one navigation stack; no own top bar

MA30.telegram: a floating tab bar for 2-5 roots, BackButton for depth; no drawer

MA15.telegram: gate members newer than 6.0 with isVersionAtLeast

MA28.telegram: Stars as the sign before a whole number, grams as '12.5 GRAM'

MA29.telegram: no own verified or Premium marks; trust in text

MA05.telegram: theme roles (--tma-*) from --tg-theme-*; brand colour on one moment

MA10.telegram: infinite motion only on loaders and live data

MA11.telegram: emphasis by size and weight, solid colour

MA12.telegram: glass only on floating controls, with a solid fallback

MA13.telegram: no emoji anywhere: kit icons or one open SVG library (Lucide first); the Stars sign as the .tma-star SVG

MA31.telegram: plain statements: the screen's title, what the thing does, real numbers

MA32.telegram: flat grouped surfaces; a pressed state instead of hover effects

MA21.telegram: show the information, or reveal it on tap

MA24.telegram: a label for every input, alt for every image

MA34.telegram: sentence case in the type roles (caption, footnote)

MA35.telegram: one surface level: rows inside one card or list; a second level is a pushed screen or a sheet

MA36.telegram: one haptic per user moment, paired with a visible change; never on scroll, typing or timers

MA37.telegram: start sensors on a user action, stop them when the screen closes or the app hides

MA38.telegram: every control has a name a screen reader can say; icons are aria-hidden
MA38.kit: aria-label on the button, .tma-sr-only for glyph amounts

MA39.telegram: logical properties, so the layout mirrors for Arabic, Hebrew and Persian
MA39.kit: tma.css uses inline-start / -end; tma.locale() sets dir

MA40.telegram: amounts and codes as text with inputmode, parsed in the user's locale

MA41.telegram: the keyboard opens on the user's tap, never on launch

MA42.telegram: kind and status in a tag, an icon or the section header

MA43.telegram: depth from theme surfaces; soft shadow only for floating things

MA44.telegram: the heading alone, in the type scale

MA45.telegram: a tab bar of 2-5 sections, each a line icon that means its label plus a short label; the selected tab drawn by the kit

MA46.telegram: fullscreen on iOS / Android (8.0+) with safe areas, the expanded sheet elsewhere

MA47.telegram: every nested screen and sheet on one stack the BackButton pops; the screen underneath keeps its scroll

MA48.telegram: surfaces 16 px apart, content 16 px from the sides and 12-16 px from top and bottom, one radius scale

patterns.web: a carousel library or auto-playing slider
patterns.telegram: a horizontal scroll row of tiles, or a gallery opened as a pushed photo viewer
showPopup for a decision, a bottom sheet for content
a snackbar plus a haptic; showAlert only when the user must read it
a segmented control inside a screen; a tab bar for app sections

patterns.web: a grid of identical stat cards
patterns.telegram: one hero figure and the rest as a key-value list or rows
a quiet tag text, one per card

patterns.web: a price in a coloured pill
patterns.telegram: the price in headline weight under the meta
the native date input in a picker pill, or a day strip with slots for booking
a pop-up menu row or the native select
Telegram draws the header: set its colour, put the title in a large title
map Tailwind colours to the --tma-* roles (rework.md section 6)
point the shadcn variables at the --tma-* roles (rework.md section 6)

manual: States: loading (skeleton), empty, error with retry, disabled and success for every list and action (design-system.md section 8)
Layout: describe each list and detail screen as a screen JSON and run miniapp_layout.py review (layout-rules.md)
Copy: the first line of every screen says what it is; buttons say what happens (anti-slop.md section 4)
Chrome: header, background and bottom bar colours set before ready() (tma.chrome)
Preview: both themes, iOS and Android, 320-430 px, fullscreen, every style the app ships
